rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the resolute, unshakable side of figurative “steely.”

example.english: We remained steely even under such enormous pressure.
example.traditional: 面對咁大嘅壓力，我哋依然好堅定。
example.jyutping: min6 deoi3 gam3 daai6 ge3 aat3 lik6 ngo5 dei6 ji1 jin4 hou2 gin1 ding6

rows.note: Use this for the cold, stern quality of a steely gaze or expression, rather than for plain determination.

example.english: Their steely gaze made the whole meeting room fall silent.
example.traditional: 佢冷峻嘅目光，令成個會議室即刻靜晒。
example.jyutping: keoi5 laang5 zeon3 ge3 muk6 gwong1 ling6 seng4 go3 wui6 ji5 sat1 zik1 hak1 zing6 saai3

rows.note: Use this when something is literally made of steel rather than merely seeming tough or determined.

example.english: This steely table is so heavy that we cannot move it.
example.traditional: 呢張枱係鋼做嘅，重到搬唔郁。
example.jyutping: nei1 zoeng1 ci4 hai6 gong3 zou6 ge3 cung5 dou3 bun1 m4 juk1
